body:
**Commit after sprint report revision 2.** The owner approved committing the 2026-10-19 fixes that report revision 2 lists as uncommitted. They are commit `8fcc89e` on `codex/fwgc-procedural-campaign`, one parent `7c56032`, not pushed: 81 files.

The commit leaves out `docs/research/map-epic-2-findings.md` (another session's work) and the `.darkmechanicus` state files.

The source is the same as the working tree that package `e20f2667…` was built from and that the final one-shot run, the clean install and the offline suites tested. No source changed after the package was built.
